definitions.explanation: the act of moving a plant to a new pot or location

examples.japanese: ⟦{観葉植物|かんようしょくぶつ}→観葉植物：19239_kanyoushokubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{植|う}え{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{植|う}え{替|か}え⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Spring is a good season for repotting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まって→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{植|う}え{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The roots are getting crowded, so repotting is needed.

notes:
{植|う}え{替|か}え refers to moving a plant to a new pot or location, typically to promote better growth.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {植|う}え{替|か}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do repotting
- {植|う}え{替|か}える: to repot (verb form)
- {植|う}え{替|か}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: repotting season

WHEN TO REPOT:
- {根詰|ねづ}まり: root-bound condition
- ⟦{鉢|はち}→鉢：29581_hachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧: pot has become too small
- ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧: soil has become old/depleted

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{移植|いしょく}→移植：13761_ishoku⟧: transplanting (more formal/technical; also used for organ transplants)
- {定植|ていしょく}: permanent planting (from seedbed to final location)

Spring is the most common time for {植|う}え{替|か}え, as plants recover more easily during the growing season.
